result.markdown:
For most small companies, I would narrow the search to **BambooHR, Rippling, Gusto, and Zoho People**\.

My top recommendation depends on whether you want a complete HR management system or something that also handles payroll.

## Best HR software for small businesses (2026)

![How to Use BambooHR - Getting Started Guide (2026) | Delv](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1eEILrPS5kwPkgNwYw7R5-fSnQEm5WOJ3mO9wAe9tHrox_ii2fkN7RtteSGmwi-6qitJLoQZs1FRAP2kjVoJ49Jp-AjTjDQtr9b5VlRxrraDCzcOaPuqAcc3XeVxoctViebYCP_ecjlJwjlD7MBkZOx5riXcchKDVW9q8jz3YTQ7r9I5oNzcVbSfteMz5-Pg?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. BambooHR**

(Best overall for HR)

Employee records, onboarding, time-off management, performance reviews, reporting and employee self-service.

Best if you want to organize and professionalize your HR department.

Pricing varies; small-business minimums may apply.

[Official website](https://www.bamboohr.com/)

---

![Rippling Company Profile Funding & Investors | YourStory](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/SAzMvIL6PtbUMLb8gBTabCeVnrSEXbTwCT-aC0SC4jJFQ74dXv0idEYA-gW8Xf4QyVq2JUnFjv2iQman7uk3D8kUDVp4a4whGwY7X8hxbhcNKKU6eqdr0HQC44Yinb10-d1Qx8pYpUGPKlk3izjNGAFETr0jiBpGuRO01GQ7GCiUG98Lat9yOYtjvREa50cA?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Rippling**

(Best all-in-one automation)

HR, payroll, benefits, employee onboarding, IT access and workflow automation.

Best if you are growing quickly and want multiple business systems connected.

Starting prices reported around \$8/employee/month plus a base fee.

[Official website](https://www.rippling.com/)

---

![Gusto: The all-in-one people platform for payroll, benefits, HR | Product Hunt](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/U9ihkiZChKRcgqjjRClvDRyT9XG9-GpMyinllUWob9alMftBmPGRcobY-YvDUQKw1cvVb4T3cEeJpN5ErI9IqBVMrrh8CobtTNAx_DYMZG5QgeYUTUHnLdeuUVTXGf9kQQbmuo-8rs3UnMu94W26KU8QJR6ha5lcvmllFK9LSsVoa23KAvlPVkN4pktlksyv?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Gusto**

(Best for payroll + HR)

Payroll, tax filing, benefits, onboarding and basic HR management.

Best if payroll is your biggest administrative headache.

US-focused; starting plan reported at \$49/month plus \$6/person.

[Official website](https://gusto.com/)

---

![Introducing Zoho People 5.0 | Streamlined & secure HR software](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/N2tyoCYDXo_2X8HD_5-SWCfDBpBrfnJxvS27zq0luRDcSBxvb5ksF8GIcSrns-PjyFB81AcM6r9iE-CSXiUONYeUFYVq66I46rVVwsJXPLlWkRDDpj17x51dneUMDGMOeIbB1fDSAq7EtcK5moqwY1sb0xYonWwdnsoigFpIV0zzd1uQR8FzhmzsLBPdP8qA?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Zoho People**

(Best budget option)

Employee records, leave management, attendance, workflows and performance management.

Best if you want an affordable HR system without paying for features you don't need.

Free tier and paid plans available; pricing depends on plan.

[Official website](https://www.zoho.com/people/)

These recommendations reflect current 2026 software comparisons. ## Important: If your company is in Canada

I would change my shortlist slightly. Canadian payroll and provincial employment compliance matter, particularly if you operate in Quebec.

My Canadian shortlist would be\:

| Software | Best for |
|--------|--------|
| Employment Hero (Humi) | All-in-one Canadian HR and payroll |
| Collage HR | HR, benefits and employee management |
| Rise People | HR, payroll and benefits |
| Folks HR | Bilingual French/English HR |
| BambooHR | Dedicated HR management |


For Quebec, I'd particularly investigate Humi by Employment Hero and Folks HR. Verify French-language support, CNESST-related workflows, Revenu Québec remittances and RL-1 slips before signing. search_results.description: TechRadar’s 2026 guide evaluates leading HR software for payroll, compliance, recruitment, onboarding, benefits, performance management, and employee administration. Gusto is named best overall for its full-service payroll, time tracking, benefits administration, compliance support, and HR guidance. Employment Hero is recommended for small and medium-sized businesses because of its customizable workflows, automation, AI assistant, and broad feature set, though advanced functions and add-ons can increase costs. Rippling is best for versatility, particularly for distributed teams, offering remote device management, tax registration, scalable services, and per-employee billing. Other recommendations include Remote Payroll for international enterprises, BambooHR as an all-in-one system, Zoho People for integrations, Breathe HR for simple employee management, Deel for powerful global HR capabilities, PeopleHR for mobile access, Paylocity for mid-sized businesses, Staffology Payroll for complex enterprise payroll, Workable for recruitment, and BrightHR for extensive workforce-management features. The guide advises selecting software according to company size and specific workflow needs, and explains that testing considered usability, features, security, support, pricing, and user feedback.
